entities.summary: Donald Vincent Davies is a Canadian lawyer and politician who has been the member of Parliament (MP) for Vancouver Kingsway since 2008. A member of the New Democratic Party (NDP), Davies was selected to be interim party leader in 2025 and served until the election of Avi Lewis in the 2026 leadership election.
